title: A Safer Way to the Bus Stop
section: 听力篇章 · 社区生活
transcript:
A new footpath opened on Monday in a neighbourhood on the east side of Millbrook. The path connects three apartment buildings with the bus stop on Green Lane. In the past, residents had to walk along a busy road to reach the stop. Many asked the council for a safer route after a survey showed that nearly half the people who walked there were travelling with children. The council first considered moving the bus stop, but the bus company said a different stop would be too close to a road crossing.

The new path runs behind the buildings, along the edge of a small public garden. A gate at each end makes it easy to enter, and the path is wide enough for two people with pushchairs to pass. At first, the design included steps near the bus stop. These were replaced with a gentle slope after a resident pointed out that the steps would be difficult for wheelchair users.

The council had planned to open the path last month. Work was delayed because heavy rain made it impossible to lay the final surface. The first passengers used the path on Monday morning. One resident told our reporter that the new route saved her only a minute, but made the walk much less stressful. The council will count how many people use the path over the next six weeks before deciding whether to add lights along it.

questions.prompt: Why did residents ask for a safer route to the bus stop?
options: Many people walked there with children.
The bus service had become less frequent.
The usual route passed through private gardens.
The bus company planned to close the stop.
questions.answer: Many people walked there with children.
questions.explanation: 调查显示，接近一半步行去车站的人带着孩子，因此居民要求更安全的路线。

questions.prompt: How did the council improve access near the bus stop?
options: It moved the stop to the other side of the road.
It replaced the planned steps with a gentle slope.
questions.answer: It replaced the planned steps with a gentle slope.
questions.explanation: 为方便轮椅使用者，车站附近原计划的台阶改成了缓坡。

questions.prompt: What delayed the opening of the new footpath?
options: A late delivery of the gates.
A disagreement with the bus company.
A change in the route through the garden.
Heavy rain during the final stage of work.
questions.answer: Heavy rain during the final stage of work.
questions.explanation: 大雨导致工人无法铺设最后一层路面，因此步道延迟开放。

questions.prompt: What will the council do before deciding whether to install lights?
options: Ask the bus company to pay for them.
Count how many people use the path.
Open the garden in the evening.
Compare the cost of moving the bus stop.
questions.answer: Count how many people use the path.
questions.explanation: 委员会将在接下来六周统计步道使用人数，再决定是否增加照明。
